title: Stunning crypto treasury mNAV slide puts 4% of Bitcoin at risk as Ethereum remains strong
summary: Digital asset treasuries have come under renewed pressure after a sharp drop in their market net asset values, or mNAVs, raising doubts about their ability to sustain continued crypto purchases, according to Geoffrey Kendrick, head of digital assets research at Standard Chartered.
